explanation: Green's bound W(3,r) ≫ exp(c(log r)^{4/3−o(1)}), encoded with an existential o(r) → 0. Because o is existentially chosen yet must tend to 0, the exponent (log r)^{4/3−o(r)} still eventually exceeds any multiple of log r, so the statement is not trivial and is a faithful rendering of the bound.
